identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Neratinib Plus Capecitabine Versus Lapatinib Plus Capecitabine in Patients With HER2+ Metastatic Breast Cancer Who Have Received Two or More Prior HER2 Directed Regimens in the Metastatic Setting
identificationModule.officialTitle: A STUDY OF NERATINIB PLUS CAPECITABINE VERSUS LAPATINIB PLUS CAPECITABINE IN PATIENTS WITH HER2+ METASTATIC BREAST CANCER WHO HAVE RECEIVED TWO OR MORE PRIOR HER2-DIRECTED REGIMENS IN THE METASTATIC SETTING (NALA)

armGroups.label: neratinib plus capecitabine
armGroups.description: neratinib 240 mg orally, once daily with food, continuously in 21 day cycles, and capecitabine 1500 mg/m\^2 daily in 2 evenly divided doses, orally with water within 30 minutes after a meal, taken on days 1 to 14 of each 21 day cycle.

armGroups.label: lapatinib plus capecitabine
armGroups.description: lapatinib 1250 mg orally, once daily, continuously in 21 day cycles, and capecitabine 2000 mg/m\^2 daily in 2 evenly divided doses, orally with water within 30 minutes after a meal, taken on days 1 to 14 of each 21 day cycle.
